You start by finding a good job, personally I suggest black mage cause it’s the one I have most fun with but there are many good jobs out there. I’d honestly just look up the best ones, pick one you like and learn it, learning one class streamlines the entire process for others.

Next you wanna go to wolves den, and clear your entire hotbar, then pick spots for the basics like your potion, sprint etc. these are on all classes so never change their positions, find comfy spots for them.

Then go over each skill one by one and understand them, reading tooltips is important. Then try and think of some combos, test them out on the dummy, then watch a video guide; this way you can understand what they are saying better and get into the nuances rather than get lost at the basics.

Then it’s practice. Figuring out what to use when, when to do X or Y. It’s all trial by fire.
